name: Worn Boots
description: Your own two feet and whatever you can sling over your shoulders. Slow, but it costs nothing.

name: Handcart
description: A simple two-wheeled cart. More weight, no faster, but your back will thank you.

name: Ox Wagon
description: A sturdy wagon drawn by a pair of oxen. Real cargo capacity, at the cost of needing wide roads.

name: River Barge
description: A flat-bottomed barge for river and coastal routes. Fast and roomy, but useless inland.

name: The Ledgerwind Caravan
description: A grand, guarded caravan train of wagons and pack animals capable of crossing any terrain in the reach. The mark of a wayfarer who has truly arrived.
